name: homelab
title: Homelab
description: Your whole homelab in Raycast: stats, downloads, media requests, monitors, music, photos, books, documents, services, jobs, DNS, backups and money — one hub, every service optional.
author: aleksandar

preferences.name: configFile
preferences.title: Env File
preferences.description: Optional dotenv file that supplies any setting left empty here. Keys are UPPER_SNAKE (JELLYFIN_URL, JELLYFIN_API_KEY…). See .env.example.

preferences.name: glancesUrl
preferences.title: Glances URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Glances instance. Leave empty to hide Glances features.

preferences.name: storageMount
preferences.title: Extra Mount Point
preferences.description: A second filesystem from Glances to show next to / (e.g. a data SSD). Leave empty to show only the root filesystem.

preferences.name: tempsUrl
preferences.title: Temperatures JSON URL
preferences.description: Optional URL of a temps.json published by the companion temps-publish script (server CPU/disk + NAS disk temps).

preferences.name: homepageUrl
preferences.title: Dashboard URL
preferences.description: Optional link to your dashboard (Homepage, Dashy…) shown in the menu bar and Home links.

preferences.name: truenasUrl
preferences.title: TrueNAS URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your TrueNAS instance. Leave empty to hide TrueNAS features.

preferences.name: truenasApiKey
preferences.title: TrueNAS API Key
preferences.description: Read-only key is enough (pool capacity + health). Leave empty to hide the NAS row.

preferences.name: qbitUrl
preferences.title: qBittorrent URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your qBittorrent instance. Leave empty to hide qBittorrent features.

preferences.name: qbitUsername
preferences.title: qBittorrent Username
preferences.description: Web UI username.

preferences.name: qbitPassword
preferences.title: qBittorrent Password
preferences.description: Web UI password. Never attempted while empty (qBittorrent IP-bans after 5 failures).

preferences.name: sabnzbdUrl
preferences.title: SABnzbd URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your SABnzbd instance. Leave empty to hide SABnzbd features.

preferences.name: sabnzbdApiKey
preferences.title: SABnzbd API Key
preferences.description: Config → General → API Key.

preferences.name: slskdUrl
preferences.title: slskd URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your slskd instance. Leave empty to hide slskd features.

preferences.name: slskdApiKey
preferences.title: slskd API Key
preferences.description: Options → Web → Authentication → API keys.

preferences.name: jellyfinUrl
preferences.title: Jellyfin URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Jellyfin instance. Leave empty to hide Jellyfin features.

preferences.name: jellyfinApiKey
preferences.title: Jellyfin API Key
preferences.description: Dashboard → API Keys.

preferences.name: jellyfinUserId
preferences.title: Jellyfin User ID
preferences.description: Optional. Whose Continue Watching / Next Up to show; defaults to the first administrator.

preferences.name: jellyseerrUrl
preferences.title: Jellyseerr URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Jellyseerr instance. Leave empty to hide Jellyseerr features.

preferences.name: jellyseerrApiKey
preferences.title: Jellyseerr API Key
preferences.description: Settings → General → API Key (admin).

preferences.name: radarrUrl

preferences.name: radarrApiKey
preferences.title: Radarr API Key

preferences.name: sonarrUrl

preferences.name: chaptarrApiKey

preferences.name: navidromeUrl

preferences.name: calibreUrl

preferences.name: calibrePassword

preferences.name: paperlessUrl
preferences.title: Paperless URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Paperless-ngx instance. Leave empty to hide Paperless features.

preferences.name: paperlessToken
preferences.title: Paperless API Token
preferences.description: Your Paperless profile → API Auth Token. Documents must be visible to this user.

preferences.name: metubeUrl
preferences.title: MeTube URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your MeTube instance. Leave empty to hide MeTube features.

preferences.name: metubeFolders
preferences.title: MeTube Destinations
preferences.description: Comma-separated extra folders as folder|Label[|video]. Add |video to download video instead of opus audio. Example: music|Music,clips|Clips|video

preferences.name: kumaUrl
preferences.title: Uptime Kuma URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Uptime Kuma instance. Leave empty to hide Uptime Kuma features.

preferences.name: kumaStatusSlug
preferences.title: Uptime Kuma Status Page Slug
preferences.description: Slug of a public status page (used when no API key is set).

preferences.name: kumaApiKey
preferences.title: Uptime Kuma API Key
preferences.description: Settings → API Keys. With a key every monitor is read from /metrics, not just the status page.

preferences.name: ntfyUrl
preferences.title: ntfy URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your ntfy instance. Leave empty to hide ntfy features.

preferences.name: ntfyTopics
preferences.title: ntfy Topics
preferences.description: Comma-separated topics to read.

preferences.name: adguardUrl
preferences.title: AdGuard Home URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your AdGuard Home instance. Leave empty to hide AdGuard Home features.

preferences.name: adguardUsername
preferences.title: AdGuard Home Username
preferences.description: Web UI username.

preferences.name: adguardPassword
preferences.title: AdGuard Home Password
preferences.description: Web UI password.

preferences.name: komodoUrl
preferences.title: Komodo URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Komodo instance. Leave empty to hide Komodo features.

preferences.name: komodoApiKey
preferences.title: Komodo API Key
preferences.description: Settings → Profile → API keys.

preferences.name: komodoApiSecret
preferences.title: Komodo API Secret
preferences.description: Shown once when the key is created.

preferences.name: servicesSshHost
preferences.title: Services SSH Host
preferences.description: SSH destination for Services & Jobs: user@host or an alias from ~/.ssh/config. Uses noninteractive key or agent authentication and a previously trusted host key. Leave empty to disable.

preferences.name: servicesSshPort
preferences.title: Services SSH Port
preferences.description: Optional SSH port (1–65535). Leave empty to use your SSH configuration or port 22.

preferences.name: servicesSshIdentityFile
preferences.title: Services SSH Identity File
preferences.description: Optional path to your local SSH private key; ~/ is supported. Leave empty to use your SSH configuration or agent. Enter a file path, never the key itself.

preferences.name: backrestUrl
preferences.title: Backrest URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Backrest instance. Leave empty to hide Backrest features.

preferences.name: backrestUsername
preferences.title: Backrest Username
preferences.description: Web UI username.

preferences.name: backrestPassword
preferences.title: Backrest Password
preferences.description: Web UI password.

preferences.name: backrestGraceHours
preferences.title: Backup Freshness Grace (Hours)
preferences.description: Extra time beyond each backup/check schedule before it is overdue. Defaults to 2 hours. Manual plans have no deadline.

preferences.name: scrutinyUrl
preferences.title: Scrutiny URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Scrutiny instance. Leave empty to hide Scrutiny features.

preferences.name: speedtestUrl
preferences.title: Speedtest Tracker URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Speedtest Tracker instance. Leave empty to hide Speedtest Tracker features.

preferences.name: fireflyUrl
preferences.title: Firefly III URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Firefly III instance. Leave empty to hide Firefly III features.

preferences.name: fireflyToken
preferences.title: Firefly III Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Options → Profile → OAuth → Personal Access Tokens.

preferences.name: picoUrl
preferences.title: Firefly Pico URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Firefly Pico instance. Leave empty to hide Firefly Pico features.

preferences.name: subscriptionsUrl
preferences.title: Subscriptions JSON URL
preferences.description: Optional URL of a subscriptions.json published by the companion firefly-sub-publish script (upcoming bills summary).

preferences.name: forgejoUrl
preferences.title: Forgejo / Gitea URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Forgejo / Gitea instance. Leave empty to hide Forgejo / Gitea features.

preferences.name: nextcloudUrl
preferences.title: Nextcloud URL
preferences.description: Base URL of Nextcloud, including its subpath if any.

preferences.name: nextcloudUsername
preferences.title: Nextcloud Username
preferences.description: Your Nextcloud user ID (not display name).

preferences.name: nextcloudAppPassword
preferences.title: Nextcloud App Password
preferences.description: Create an app password in Nextcloud → Personal settings → Security.
